mapper.select: SELECT id, title, detail, category, priority, due_date, completed, completed_at, created_at, updated_at FROM todos WHERE id = #{id}
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO todos (title, detail, category, priority, due_date, completed) VALUES (#{title}, #{detail}, #{category}, #{priority}, #{dueDate}, COALESCE(#{completed}, FALSE))
mapper.update: UPDATE todos SET title = #{title}, detail = #{detail}, category = #{category}, priority = #{priority}, due_date = #{dueDate}, completed_at = CASE WHEN completed = FALSE AND #{completed} = TRUE THEN CURRENT_TIMESTAMP WHEN completed = TRUE AND #{completed} = FALSE THEN NULL ELSE completed_at END, completed = #{completed} WHERE id = #{id}
